other_conditions: The construction worker must be registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board for at least one year
The worker must have purchased a lithium‑ion battery high‑speed two‑wheeler in his own name
The worker must hold a valid license to drive two‑wheelers
The benefit is available only once per registered construction worker
The worker cannot sell the vehicle for three years after purchase
benefits_summary: One‑time subsidy of up to 50% of the battery‑operated two‑wheeler price or ₹30,000 (whichever is lower), plus reimbursement of the registration fee and road tax for the first purchase.
